# COSCUP 2026 BoF / Hacking Corners 參與辦法及使用規則 Participation Guidelines and Usage Rules

COSCUP 大會是台灣乃至全球開源愛好者的年度盛事 ；

每年吸引來自世界各地的開放文化愛好者參加。如果你熱愛開源，尋找志同道合的朋友，不妨加入我們的 BoF / Hacking Room 活動！

在 2026 年的 COSCUP 中，來與朋友一起參加 BoF 會議或 hacking rooms 吧！

Meet friends at the BoF sessions or hacking rooms of COSCUP 2026!

## BoF (Birds of Feather flock together)

- **時間 / Time: Aug 8th and 9th, 10:00 - 16:00**
- **活動場地 / Location: Room TR310-2**

想象一下，在一個充滿激情的房間裡，你與一群同樣狂熱的開源愛好者圍坐一起，分享著那些只有“內行人”才懂的秘密。從未來技術的預測到那些奇妙的代碼秘籍，BoF 讓你的每一次對話都精彩絕倫！。

COSCUP 年會聚集開放源碼社群成員，是舉辦和開源、社群及開放文化有關開源相關主題 BoF 的絕佳環境！

Imagine being in a room bursting with passion, sitting in a circle with a group of equally enthusiastic open-source aficionados, sharing secrets known only to insiders. From predicting future technologies to uncovering marvelous coding hacks, BoF sessions make every conversation extraordinarily engaging!

The COSCUP annual conference gathers members of the open-source community, providing an excellent environment for hosting BoFs on topics related to open source, community, and open culture.

加入我們的 BoF 聚會，與來自全球的開源同好一起享受這場技術與情感的盛宴。預約你的 BoF 時間 （每場次一小時），讓這個周末成為你與朋友們的技術樂園。記得 至 [此文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZerJ-5QYcEJ5guhxtK-SBW2BA6RMHtVJnqNIWxRCz18/edit?usp=sharing&tab=t.0#heading=h.fxmha6h81nfm) 閱讀注意事項並登記；同時，也歡迎在此宣傳場外自行舉辦的開源聚會 ！

想參加活動的會眾也可以在這份文件找到有哪些有趣的活動正在發生！

We encourage communities to hold their BoF meet-up during COSCUP. Book for your BoF (1 hr per session) and check up the notice  [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZerJ-5QYcEJ5guhxtK-SBW2BA6RMHtVJnqNIWxRCz18/edit?usp=sharing&tab=t.0#heading=h.fxmha6h81nfm) , or promote your own BoFs during the weekend!

## Hacking Room

- **時間 / Time: Aug 8th and 9th, 10:00 - 16:00**
- **活動場地 / Location: Room** [TR309外走廊、TR409外走廊](https://coscup.org/2025/venue/)

過往很多 BoF 主揪敲碗每場次一小時不夠讓大夥暢談…我們今年提供不限時的 hacking room 空間！

Hacking Room 是一個能容納 10 人左右的區域，供會眾自由交流！在這裡，我時間是你的朋友。這是一個可以從快速打牌遊戲到進行長達數小時的開源馬拉松的多功能空間。無論是15分鐘的急速腦力激盪還是一場兩小時的代碼冒險，這裡都是實現你的創意與夢想的場所。

The hacking room is a free space for casual gatherings, which can hold up to 10 people. There is no time limit in the hacking room. You can play card games with friends for 15 minutes between talks or run a two-hour open-source sprint here. Also, multiple events are available at the same time. It is all up to you!

如果你想要揪人參與在 hacking room 舉行的活動，歡迎在 [此文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZerJ-5QYcEJ5guhxtK-SBW2BA6RMHtVJnqNIWxRCz18/edit?tab=t.0) 登記宣傳！

想參加活動的會眾也可以在這份文件找到有哪些有趣的活動正在發生！

Share your event  [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZerJ-5QYcEJ5guhxtK-SBW2BA6RMHtVJnqNIWxRCz18/edit?tab=t.0)  to invite other attendees to join in!

## 1. 什麼是 BoF？和議程有什麼不一樣？

BoF（Birds of a Feather）是一種由與會社群或參與者自主發起的小型聚會，形式彈性、主題不限。不同於主議程由大會策劃與審核，BoF 鼓勵任何人針對特定議題自發討論、交流，強調「興趣導向」與「雙向參與」。

## 2. 如何舉辦 BoF?

## 3. 如何參加 BoF？

- 事前在電子佈告欄的[揪團區](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZerJ-5QYcEJ5guhxtK-SBW2BA6RMHtVJnqNIWxRCz18/edit?usp=sharing&tab=t.0#heading=h.9ut5dwzgvylt)+1
- 也可在現場直接前往 BoF Room（TR310-2）門口查看最新告示，無需報名，自由進出與參與討論

## 4. 會場外也有 BoF！

## 5. 什麼是 Hacking Corner？

Hacking Corner 是現場開放空間（過去稱為 Hacking Room），讓會眾可臨時揪團進行共創、開發、技術交流等非正式活動。每個位置可約容納 10 人，不需事前申請，現場自由使用。

## 6. Hacking Corner 和 BoF 有什麼不同？

## 7. 如何使用 Hacking Corner？

- **地點**：TR309 / TR409 外走廊（08/08–08/09）
- **同時段可能有多個討論，**請尊重他人
- 適合程式共創、討論、打開 source code 一起研究等活動

## 8. 如何尋找/宣傳在 Hacking Corner 的活動？

- 可隨時於[電子佈告欄](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZerJ-5QYcEJ5guhxtK-SBW2BA6RMHtVJnqNIWxRCz18/edit?usp=sharing)宣傳或查詢
- 社群媒體標註 #coscup 或 #coscup2026 讓更多人知道

如需進一步協助，歡迎聯繫議程組 program@coscup.org 希望你在 COSCUP 玩得盡興，也創造出屬於你的交流時刻！

## 1. What is a BoF? How is it different from regular sessions?

BoF (Birds of a Feather) refers to informal meetups initiated by communities or participants. They are flexible in format and open in topics. Unlike official sessions curated by the organizing team, BoFs are interest-driven and encourage open, two-way participation and discussion around any topic.

## 2. How to host a BoF?

## 3. How to participate in a BoF?

- Join a group in advance via the**[BoF sign-up section](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZerJ-5QYcEJ5guhxtK-SBW2BA6RMHtVJnqNIWxRCz18/edit?usp=sharing&tab=t.0#heading=h.9ut5dwzgvylt)** on the Electronic Bulletin Board
- You can also go directly to the BoF Room (TR310-2) on-site and check the latest notices. No registration is required—feel free to enter and join the discussion.

## 4. There are BoFs outside the venue too!

## 5. What is the Hacking Corner?

The Hacking Corner is an open space at the venue (previously called Hacking Room) where attendees can spontaneously gather to co-create, develop, or engage in informal tech exchanges. Each area accommodates about 10 people. No prior reservation is needed—use the space freely on-site.

## 6. Difference between Hacking Corner and BoF

## 7. How to use the Hacking Corners?

- **Location**: Corridors outside TR309 / TR409 (08/08–08/09)
- **No reservation required**: Use any available spot
- **Multiple discussions may happen simultaneously**, please be respectful
- Great for co-coding, idea exchange, open-source collaboration, etc.

## 8. How to find or promote Hacking Corner activities?

- Promote or check events anytime on the [Electronic Bulletin Board](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZerJ-5QYcEJ5guhxtK-SBW2BA6RMHtVJnqNIWxRCz18/edit?usp=sharing)
- Use hashtags #coscup or #coscup2026 on social media to spread the word

If you need further assistance, feel free to contact the Program Team at program@coscup.org. We hope you have a great time at COSCUP and create your own memorable moments of connection!
